title: Visible luminescent Ln42 nanotorus coordination clusters

synthesis.procedure: Eu(OAc)3·4H2O and the tert-butyl imine Schiff-base ligand HL were combined in 1:1 ethanol/toluene with triethylamine and refluxed for 1 h. After cooling and filtration, diethyl ether vapor was allowed to diffuse into the filtrate at room temperature for one week. The crystals were washed with diethyl ether and dried under a nitrogen stream.
synthesis.temperature: Reflux; then room temperature for crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: 250 mL single-neck round-bottom flask with reflux condenser; diethyl ether vapor diffusion into filtrate in a sealed jar
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cool, filter, distribute filtrate among three test tubes, and expose to diethyl ether vapor from 300 mL of ether. Decant supernatant; wash crystals with diethyl ether (2 × 5 mL) and dry under nitrogen.
synthesis.yield: 32.1 mg, 24% based on europium acetate tetrahydrate

properties.summary: Visible Eu(III) emission with characteristic 5D0 → 7F0–4 transitions; weak ligand fluorescence accompanies the metal-centered emission.

measurements.name: Relative solution quantum yield
measurements.conditions: MeCN; Ru(bpy)3Cl2 reference; estimated relative error ±15%

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row for Eu42

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: An approximately 35 Å-wide, 12 Å-thick torus with an approximately 14 Å inner cavity. Its 42 Eu(III) centers form a ring with a repeating three-metal motif and 14-fold architectural repetition; the proposed assembly from trinuclear groups is not an observed intermediate.

synthesis.procedure: The procedure for 1 was repeated with Tb(OAc)3·4H2O in place of the Eu salt: the metal acetate, HL, and triethylamine in 1:1 ethanol/toluene were refluxed for 1 h, cooled, and filtered. Diethyl ether vapor diffusion into the filtrate at room temperature afforded yellow crystals after one week, which were collected as for 1.
synthesis.temperature: Reflux; then room temperature for crystallization
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Shared procedure for 1: reflux in a round-bottom flask followed by diethyl ether vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Cool and filter; crystallize by diethyl ether vapor diffusion for one week, then collect and wash the yellow crystals as described for 1.
synthesis.yield: 24.4 mg, 18% based on terbium acetate tetrahydrate

properties.summary: Visible Tb(III) emission is accompanied by strong ligand fluorescence; its relative solution quantum yield is low, and an emission lifetime could not be determined directly.

measurements.name: Relative solution quantum yield
measurements.conditions: Solution measurement using quinine sulfate reference

source_locations.location: Supplied CCDC catalog row for Tb42

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: An isostructural 42-metal nanotorus with the 14-fold architecture described for 1.
